_note: Draft English of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Bereshit 48 (Jacob blesses Ephraim and Manasseh). Saadia-specific: v.3 'אלטאיק אלכאפי' = 'the Sufficient Power' (consistent); v.16 'במלך פכני' = 'who through His angel released me' for המלאך הגאל אתי (Saadia preserves 'angel' but treats it as God's intermediary); v.22 'חצה זאידא' = 'an additional portion' for שכם אחד על אחיך (Saadia interprets שכם as 'portion').

translations.1: And it was after these things, that Joseph was told: 'Behold, your father is ill.' And he took his two sons with him — Manasseh and Ephraim.
translations.2: Then Jacob was told, saying: 'Behold, your son Joseph is coming to you.' And Israel strengthened himself, and sat up upon the bed.
translations.3: And Jacob said to Joseph: 'Know that the Sufficient Power appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan; and He blessed me.
translations.4: And He said to me: "Behold, I shall make you fruitful, and multiply you; and I shall make of you a host of nations; and I shall give this land to your offspring after you as an eternal possession."
translations.5: And now — your two sons who were born to you in the land of Egypt before I came to you in Egypt — they shall be ascribed to me; Ephraim and Manasseh shall be to me like Reuben and Simeon.
translations.6: And your offspring whom you shall beget after them shall be ascribed to you; and they shall be reckoned by the names of their brothers in their inheritance.
translations.7: And as for me — when I came from Paddan, Rachel died upon me in the land of Canaan; and a mile of distance remained for me to enter Ephrath; and I buried her there on the way to Ephrath — that is Bethlehem; and there was not born to me after that anything.'
translations.8: And when Israel saw Joseph's sons, he said: 'Who are these?'
translations.9: Joseph said to him: 'They are my sons, whom God has granted to me here.' He said: 'Bring them near to me, that I may bless them.'
translations.10: And the eyes of Israel had grown heavy from old age; he could not see. And he brought them near to him; and he kissed them and embraced them.
translations.11: Israel said to Joseph: 'To see your face I had not hoped — and behold, God has also let me see your offspring.'
translations.12: Then Joseph brought them out from upon his knees; and he bowed down with his face upon the earth.
translations.13: Then he took the two of them — Ephraim with his right hand, on the left of Israel; and Manasseh with his left hand, on the right of Israel; and he brought them near to him.
translations.14: And Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it upon the head of Ephraim, though he was the younger; and his left hand upon the head of Manasseh. He guided his hands so, although Manasseh was the firstborn.
translations.15: And he blessed Joseph, and said: 'The God in whose obedience my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked — He is the God who has shepherded me from the time I was until this day —
translations.16: the angel through whom He has rescued me from every evil — may He bless these two boys; and may my name be called upon them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and may they grow into multitudes in the midst of the earth.'
translations.17: And when Joseph saw that his father had set his right hand upon Ephraim's head, it was displeasing to him; and he supported it, to remove it from Ephraim's head to Manasseh's head.
translations.18: And he said to him: 'Not so, my father — for this one is the elder; set your right upon his head.'
translations.19: But he refused, and said: 'I know, my son; this one too shall multiply, and a nation shall be from him; but I know that his younger brother shall multiply more than he, and his offspring shall be a fullness of nations.'
translations.20: And he blessed them on that day, and said: 'In you shall the children of Israel bless, saying to one another: "May God make you as Ephraim and Manasseh."' And he set Ephraim before Manasseh.
translations.21: Then Israel said to Joseph: 'Behold, I am dying; and God shall be with you, and shall bring you back to the land of your fathers.
translations.22: And I have given you a portion greater than your brothers — which I took from the hand of the Amorites, by my sword and my bow.'
